name: pindropped-mcp
description: Find local events, notices, lost pets and small businesses on the PinDropped neighborhood map, and post pins for your user.
long_description: PinDropped (https://pindropped.app) is a neighborhood map bulletin board born on Capitol Hill in Washington, DC that works anywhere. Search live pins near a place, read a pin, share its page, or post a pin for the user after they approve it. Free pins last 12 hours; paid pins are $1/day (7 days for $7) or $20/month Permanent via Stripe checkout. No API key needed.

tools.name: search_pins
tools.description: Find live pins near a lat/lng (sorted by distance) or inside a bounding box, with an optional category filter.

tools.name: get_pin
tools.description: Read one pin's full details by id.

tools.name: pin_url
tools.description: Get the shareable https://pindropped.app/p/{id} page for a pin.

tools.name: create_pin
tools.description: Post a public pin for the user. Refuses unless user_confirmed=true; paid plans return a Stripe checkout link.
